note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1952: nominations received by W. B. O'Donoghue, clerk, 20 May 1952; contests in Bessbrook North, Camlough and Moybane, polled 5 June 1952. No party labels printed. Returned unopposed. Printed "Dorsey".
